about_the_game:
Souper Hero is a dungeon crawler roguelike fueled by the power of soup. Explore a procedurally generated world filled with friends and foes, collect ingredients, and make yourself stronger by cooking delicious soups! 

Cooking: Every ingredient has a flavor and enemies drop ingredients that augment your attack. Combine up to five ingredients in a soup and you get a completely unique weapon to play with. Though be careful, your new weapon has limited uses, so use it wisely. Some special drops have unique effects to explore, so be on the lookout!

The Dungeon: Explore a lush fantasy world full of strange (yet delicious) creatures. Find clans of local wildlife to loot and learn to traverse different biomes. Every playthrough is unique, since all content is procedurally generated. Be careful not to get lost!

The Hub: After a hard day of work (or losing all of your health) take a break at the hub. Here, you can interact with shopkeepers, cook freely, and prepare for your next traversal into the dungeon.
